facts.claim: From 1 January 2026 the Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur's taxe de séjour per person per night is, metropolitan tax plus 34% additional tax, total: palace EUR 4.80+1.63=6.43; 5-star 3.50+1.19=4.69; 4-star 2.60+0.88=3.48; 3-star 1.70+0.58=2.28; 2-star (and 4-5 star holiday resorts) 1.00+0.34=1.34; 1-star hotels, B&Bs, youth hostels 0.80+0.27=1.07; minors are exempt.
